translation.title: Orongo and Rano Kau Volcano
translation.lead: The excursion begins on the slopes of Rano Kau.

hero.alt: Stone moai on a grassy hillside on Easter Island, Chile
hero.hover: Easter Island: a row of moai on a green hillside

translation.body:
From the viewpoint, you can look across the crater and the lake within it. Continue to Orongo, the ceremonial centre of Rapa Nui.

This was the setting for the Tangata Manu, or Birdman, ritual. Representatives of different clans competed to retrieve the first egg laid by the manutara bird from a small offshore islet.

The excursion lasts approximately four hours.
